## Duplicate check

- Search the repository for the official URL and resource title.
- If the resource already has a full entry, update that entry or add a short internal cross-reference; do not create a second full description.

A reachable link is not the same as a course review. Never claim a resource or lab has been completed or verified unless that work was actually done.
